_comment: Candidate sources for the public demo's seed bundle (issue #628). Each seeded file lands in the named `collection` (ids in app.scripts.demo_seed.bundle.COLLECTIONS). Every item built from these must pass `python -m app.scripts.demo_seed validate`, and each source's licence page must be re-read and dated in license_checked_on at bundle build (docs-site/docs/operations/public-demo.md). Only the speech of people speaking in an official or professional public capacity is used; no private individual. `exclusions` are rules the curator applies when choosing recordings; FCC and OSHA were dropped on 2026-11-08 because their licence pages could not be read (see `excluded`); every remaining source's licence page was re-read that day except LibriVox, which stays out pending the owner's decision. The owner approves the final item list.

sources.name: Voice of America news reports in several languages
sources.why_allowed: VOA's copyright page: "All text, audio and video material produced exclusively by the Voice of America is in the public domain." Page checked 2026-11-08.
exclusions: Exclude any segment not produced exclusively by VOA: the page says some material is licensed for VOA programming only and is not public domain, and AFP, AP and Reuters material may not be redistributed.
Exclude street interviews and vox pops with private individuals; keep only VOA staff, officials and named experts speaking in a professional capacity.

sources.name: NTSB board meetings
sources.why_allowed: NTSB website policies: content "prepared by federal employees" is "not protected by copyright" and "may be freely copied"; copyrighted third-party items are identified as such. Checked 2026-11-08.
exclusions: Exclude any third-party text, image, audio or video the NTSB marks as copyrighted.
Exclude family-member or private-citizen statements; keep Board members and NTSB investigators in their official roles.

sources.name: FDA advisory committee meetings
sources.why_allowed: FDA website policies: "Unless otherwise noted" the contents of fda.gov "are in the public domain and may be republished, reprinted and otherwise used freely". Checked 2026-11-08.
exclusions: Exclude the open public hearing segment (private citizens, patients, and industry or advocacy speakers).

Exclude sponsor (company) presentations and slides; keep FDA staff and the committee's members. Committee members include non-federal academics: confirm each is speaking in the official committee role, and drop meetings where the recording notes a copyright.

sources.name: Federal Reserve FOMC introductory statements (Chair's prepared remarks)
sources.attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
sources.why_allowed: Board website: its information "is in the public domain and may be copied and distributed without permission"; credit the Board. Checked 2026-11-08.
exclusions: Only the Chair's prepared introductory statement is used (a single public official speaking); the reporter Q&A is not part of the clip, so no journalist is named or heard.
Exclude any photo, graphic or material the Board marks as from a non-Board source.

sources.name: SEC open meetings
sources.why_allowed: The SEC's website dissemination policy is the 'Website Dissemination' section of the page titled Privacy Information (there is no separate copyright page): information may be copied or further distributed without the SEC's permission, cite the SEC as the source, and do not use the SEC seal or other logos and artwork. Re-read 2026-11-08. Commission-produced recordings only.
exclusions: Exclude any segment from a non-SEC source and the SEC seal, logos and EDGAR marks as artwork.
Exclude public-comment speakers; keep Commissioners and staff.

sources.name: NASA education videos and podcasts
sources.why_allowed: NASA media guidelines: NASA content "generally [is] not subject to copyright in the United States" and factual, non-endorsing use needs no permission. Checked 2026-11-08. This is not a blanket public-domain grant, hence the exclusions.
exclusions: Exclude items labelled with a third-party copyright holder's name (NASA's permission does not extend to others).
Exclude children, students or other private individuals on camera or on the audio; keep NASA staff and astronauts in their official role.
Never use NASA's insignia, or a NASA employee's name or likeness, to imply endorsement.

sources.name: FEMA training and preparedness videos
sources.why_allowed: FEMA website information page, re-read 2026-11-08: 'Most material on FEMA.gov is free of copyright and may be copied and distributed without permission'; licensed or restricted photos and graphics carry a credit or copyright notice and need the source's permission; use of the DHS seal and marks is restricted.
exclusions: Exclude anything with a copyright notice or photo credit (licensed or restricted).
Exclude survivor and community interviews (private individuals); keep FEMA staff and instructors.
FEMA and DHS names and logos are not reused as branding.

sources.name: LibriVox public-domain audiobook readings
sources.attribution: LibriVox volunteer readers; recordings dedicated to the public domain
sources.why_allowed: LibriVox: "all our recordings are public domain" and volunteers' recordings "will be donated to the public domain" (public domain in the USA; other countries may differ). The underlying books are US public domain. Checked 2026-11-08.
exclusions: Use only short chapters whose catalogue page shows the recording dedicated to the public domain and a pre-1930 text.
Keep to English-language chapters read by one volunteer, with the reader credited as listed on LibriVox.
sources.notes: Decision on contains_private_individuals: the policy page says nothing about reader identity or consent, and a volunteer is a private individual who uses a (possibly real) name. Every other source here is an official speaking in a public role, which is the standard the validator's flag encodes. We therefore do NOT mark LibriVox items false on the strength of the public-domain dedication, which settles copyright, not the person's privacy. Ship LibriVox only if the owner accepts a licensed-by-dedication volunteer voice, or choose readers who publish under a clear public credit; until then the items stay out of the bundle (open_owner_decision). If approved, the curator sets the flag deliberately for each item.

sources.name: NASA mission briefings and NASA TV programmes
sources.why_allowed: NASA media guidelines: content "generally [is] not subject to copyright in the United States". Checked 2026-11-08.
exclusions: Exclude items labelled with a third-party copyright holder's name and any commercial-partner presentation.
Exclude reporters' questions from private individuals' voices where the speaker is not a named media professional; keep NASA officials, scientists and astronauts in their official roles.

sources.name: NOAA and National Weather Service briefings
sources.why_allowed: NWS disclaimer: its information "is in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise"; do not imply endorsement or alter it as official. Checked 2026-11-08.
exclusions: Exclude third-party information and imagery, which the page says is used under the provider's licence.
Exclude the NWS name and logo as branding (trademark); and media-partner or broadcaster segments.

sources.name: Redaction showcase: a scripted clip voiced by the project team with invented names, numbers and addresses
sources.why_allowed: Written and voiced by the project team and dedicated to CC0. Every personal detail is invented and the item is marked synthetic_pii: true.
exclusions: No real person's details; invented names, numbers and addresses only.

excluded.name: AMI Meeting Corpus
excluded.reason: CC BY 4.0, but the speakers are private individuals; the demo carries no private individual's voice.

excluded.name: Company earnings calls
excluded.reason: Company-owned content, not a government work or openly licensed.

excluded.name: Any Creative Commons NC or ND licence
excluded.reason: Not in the allowed licence list; NC forbids the demo's promotional use and ND forbids the transcript and summary derivatives.

excluded.name: Public-comment and open-hearing segments (FCC, FDA, SEC, NTSB)
excluded.reason: Private citizens speak; cut them from every meeting.

excluded.name: FCC open commission meetings
excluded.reason: Dropped 2026-11-08: the agency's own copyright/use page could not be read (FCC returned 403, OSHA's disclaimer and privacy URLs returned 404). 17 U.S.C. 105 would normally cover agency works, but the demo's rule is to cite and re-read the agency's own terms, so the source stays out until a person reads the page. Reinstate by reading the page and adding a source entry.

excluded.name: OSHA training and safety videos
excluded.reason: Dropped 2026-11-08: the agency's own copyright/use page could not be read (FCC returned 403, OSHA's disclaimer and privacy URLs returned 404). 17 U.S.C. 105 would normally cover agency works, but the demo's rule is to cite and re-read the agency's own terms, so the source stays out until a person reads the page. Reinstate by reading the page and adding a source entry.
